title: Finance Assistant
description:
As a Finance Assistant in the healthcare industry, based in Chester, you'll play a key role in supporting the day-to-day financial operations of the organisation. From managing invoices to assisting with reconciliations, your work will help ensure the smooth running of the accounting and finance department.

Client Details

This role is with a company in the healthcare industry located in Chester.

Description
- Process invoices, payments, and expense claims accurately and efficiently.
- Assist with bank reconciliations and maintaining financial records.
- Support the preparation of financial reports and statements.
- Maintain the accuracy of accounting ledgers and resolve discrepancies.
- Collaborate with other departments to ensure timely financial data collection.
- Provide administrative support to the accounting and finance team.
- Respond to queries related to financial transactions and records.
- Contribute to the implementation of process improvements within the finance function.

Profile

A successful Finance Assistant should have:
- Previous experience in a finance or accounting role.
- Familiarity with financial systems and software.
- Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to prioritise tasks effectively.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other relevant tools.
- A collaborative approach and a willingness to support team goals.

Job Offer
- Competitive salary ranging from £26,200 to £30,800, dependent on the level of experience.
- Permanent position in the healthcare industry.
- Opportunity to work in Chester in a finance-focused role.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant - International & Partnerships

Chester Full-time, office-based

£competitive + excellent benefits Study support Career development

Are you looking for a Finance role where you can learn, develop and build a genuine long-term career?

We're working with a large, highly successful UK consumer business to recruit a Finance Assistant into their International & Partnerships Finance team.

This is a brilliant opportunity to join a supportive Finance function and gain exposure to a fascinating area of the business, working alongside experienced Finance professionals and teams across the wider organisation.

You'll get involved in everything from Purchase Orders and Sales Ledger through to customer recharges, invoicing, claims and financial controls, while developing your understanding of how Finance supports international partnerships and commercial activity.

And importantly, this is a business that invests in its people. If you're keen to study towards AAT or continue developing your Finance qualifications, there is genuine opportunity to do so!

What will you be doing?
- Raising and processing Purchase Orders, ensuring accurate coding and approvals.
- Supporting Sales Ledger activities and maintaining accurate customer accounts.
- Raising customer recharges, sundry invoices and credits.
- Supporting customer claims and resolving queries.
- Responding to internal and external Finance queries professionally and promptly.
- Supporting month-end and wider Finance processes.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring Finance controls and procedures are followed.
- Supporting audit requirements and preparing relevant documentation.
- Working closely with colleagues across Finance and the wider business.
- Taking on additional responsibilities and learning as your knowledge develops.

What are we looking for?

You don't need to have years of Finance experience. We're looking for potential, attitude and a genuine desire to learn.

You might already have experience as an:
- Accounts Assistant
- Finance Assistant
- Sales Ledger Assistant
- Purchase Ledger Assistant
- Accounts Administrator

Or perhaps you're working in another role where you've developed strong numerical, administrative and organisational skills and now want to move into Finance.

You'll ideally have:
- Some understanding of basic accounting principles.
- Good Excel and Microsoft Office skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to meet deadlines.
- Good communication skills and confidence working with different people.
- A proactive, positive approach and willingness to learn.
- AAT qualification or an interest in studying towards a professional qualification.

Experience of systems such as SAP or Dynamics would be advantageous, but training will be provided.

Why join?

This isn't simply another Finance Assistant position.

You'll be joining a large and established business where you can genuinely build your career, with the opportunity to learn from experienced Finance professionals and gain exposure to areas of Finance you may not normally see at this level.

You'll also benefit from:
- Study and development opportunities
- Annual performance-related pay review
- 33 days' holiday, increasing with service
- Pension
- Free onsite parking
- Onsite electric vehicle charging
- Subsidised staff restaurant, including a Michelin-starred chef
- Subsidised Costa Coffee
- Staff shopping discounts
- Healthcare Cash Plan
- Private health insurance
- Long-service awards
- Christmas vouchers and savings scheme

title: Call Centre Operator - Uncapped Commission
description:
Start Date: 02/11/2026

Full Time Role - 37.5 hours per week

Stanford House Birchwood WA3 7 TH

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Warrington is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Warrington contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE
- GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.
- UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.
- BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.
- GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.
- FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.
- GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Sales Ledger Administrator
description:
RG Consultancy are working with a growing SME in Winsford who are looking to recruit a Sales Ledger Administrator to join a small accounts team. You will play an important part in bridging the accounts and sales team by managing sales orders, raising invoices and working closely with the warehouse and sales teams to ensure orders are processed accurately and efficiently.
- 25 days holiday + 8 bank holidays
- Flexible working hours
- Company pension scheme
- Free onsite carpark

Role Responsibilities
- Manage the sales ledger administration process, ensuring customer accounts and transactions are processed accurately and efficiently
- Raise and process customer invoices accurately and in a timely manner
- Ensure invoices are raised correctly against completed sales orders and dispatched goods
- Check sales orders and supporting information to ensure all details are accurate before invoicing
- Maintain accurate sales ledger and customer records within the company system
- Work closely with the accounts team to ensure sales orders, invoices and related records are kept up to date.
- Investigate and resolve any discrepancies between sales orders, goods dispatched and invoices
- Ensure the correct orders are processed and invoiced promptly
- Receive and process sales orders through the company system
- Accurately enter and maintain sales order information
- Liaise with the warehouse to ensure goods are correctly picked, prepared and dispatched
- Monitor the movement of goods in and out of the warehouse
- Check orders prior to dispatch to ensure the correct products and quantities are being sent
- Work closely with the Warehouse and Accounts teams to ensure orders are processed smoothly from receipt through to dispatch and invoicing
- Provide general sales and administrative support as required

Person specification
- Previous experience within a sales ledger, accounts or sales admin role is essential
- Strong IT skills, experience with SAGE would be an advantage
- Experience within distribution or manufacturing would be an advantage

title: Onboarding Care Coordinator
description:
On-boarding Care Coordinator (Care Pro Lead)

Brand-New Role Mileage paid at up to 45p per mile Guaranteed 37.5 hours per week

Are you an experienced Care Professional ready for a fresh challenge where you can make a real impact from day one?

Home Instead is launching an exciting new role and we're looking for a passionate, people-focused Onboarding Care Coordinator (Care Pro Lead) to support new clients through the first 30 days of their care journey.

This is a unique opportunity to combine hands-on care, client onboarding, mentoring, and relationship-building, helping clients and their families feel reassured, supported, and confident from the very start.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

This position has the benefit of a contract with 37.5 guaranteed hours per week as part of an innovative pilot programme across the Home Instead network.

This means you can enjoy the excitement of helping shape a brand-new role while benefiting from long-term career opportunities within Home Instead.

The Role

As the trusted face of Home Instead for new clients, you will:
- Support clients and their families throughout the first 30 days of care.
- Build strong relationships and confidence from the outset.
- Help establish routines and successfully implement personalised care plans.
- Ensure a smooth transition to their longer-term Care Professional team.
- Provide guidance, coaching, and mentoring to colleagues.
- Champion Home Instead's person-centred approach and high standards of care.
- Help reduce waiting times for new clients and ensure an exceptional onboarding experience.

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- An experienced Care Professional with a proven track record of delivering outstanding person-centred care.
- Qualified in Health & Social Care (NVQ/QCF or equivalent).
- A confident communicator with excellent relationship-building skills.
- Passionate about supporting, coaching, and developing others.
- In possession of an Enhanced DBS check and the Right to Work in the UK.
- A driver with a full UK driving licence and access to a vehicle (where required).

Why Join Home Instead?

This is the first Onboarding Care Coordinator role to be introduced within the Home Instead network, giving you the chance to help shape an exciting new position while working for an award-winning care provider.

If you're passionate about delivering exceptional care, supporting people through important life transitions, and want to play a key role in an innovative new approach, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: An opportunity has arisen for a part time medical receptionist to join our friendly and hardworking GP practice to cover maternity leave. As part of the Clinical Support team you will be involved in assisting the clinical staff dealing with both inbound enquiries from patients, as well as assisting outbound calls and liaising with patients. We need a motivated person who likes to be a part of the team but is also able to work independently on their own initiative. You should be flexible as additional hours may be required by mutual agreement to cover colleagues holidays and other absence. Knowledge of medical terminology and experience of working in healthcare is desired but not essential as full training will be provided. It would be beneficial if you had previous reception or administration experience, strong customer service skills, experience of using IT systems, good telephone manner and good level of resilience. The duties and responsibilities to be undertaken by members of the practice reception team may include any or all of the items in the following list. Opening up/locking-up of practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with practice protocols Processing telephone requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations and ensuring callers are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional Processing and distributing incoming and outgoing mail Taking messages and passing on information Filing and retrieving paperwork Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with practice procedures Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated healthcare agencies and providers Providing clerical assistance to practice staff as required from time to time, including filing, photocopying and scanning
